name: Rubí (Spain)
description: Red field with a yellow bend from the upper hoist corner to the fly over a white bend sinister from the upper fly corner to the lower hoist.
history: The official flag of Rubí is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a yellow bend fixed from the upper hoist corner to the inside of the fly over a white bend sinister from the upper fly corner to the lower hoist corner.

features.role: bend from the upper hoist corner, over the bend sinister
bend sinister from the upper fly corner to the lower hoist
